description: Synthetic repeated-trigger integration fixture based on an already generated signature. Not an independent realism evaluation. Two actions offered; state-conditioned exposure remains an unvalidated proxy for enacted state.

opportunities.situation: Maya asks you to clean a shared play area. Another child left the mess; you did not make it. You have time to respond and act. What do you do?

options.label: Explain that it feels unfair, then tidy the play area carefully.
options.success_text: I said that the mess was not mine, then tidied the play area carefully.
options.failure_text: I tried to tidy but struggled.

options.label: Decline the cleanup and return to your own game.
options.success_text: I declined the cleanup and returned to my game.
options.failure_text: I could not return to the game.
